fact: The AfDB execution report of 27 March 2024 records the CAB-RCA financing at UA 26.8 million and the deliverables for the Plan National Strategique Centrafrique Digitale 2025 and a broadband infrastructure master plan as 5 of 5 and 3 of 3 produced and validated.
title: Rapport sur l'etat d'execution et sur les resultats (EER), Projet Central Africa Backbone (CAB) - Composante RCA
